title: Story premise ENT036: The Teacup Lighthouse
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (miniature adventure). Hook: Three harbors. Only one is real. Takeaway/theme: Distinctive signals can distinguish otherwise similar landmarks.
description: A tiny sailor wants to guide a lost toy boat across a dark tabletop puddle, but reflections make three identical cup handles look like harbor entrances. The sailor rotates a patterned saucer under one cup, creating a distinctive moving reflection that the boat follows home.
